result.brief: 提出主动世界-动作模型，沿预测的虚拟相机轨迹想象观测，形成几何条件空间先验并压缩为记忆，经交叉注意力融合实时观测用于扩散动作预测，提升遮挡下的操作鲁棒性。
result.reason: Active world-action model imagines views along planned camera trajectories via geometry-conditioned world model, providing spatial priors for manipulation; main contribution is embodied policy, so secondary direction.
